process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before executing with `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied` (observed on `gh pr view 224 ...`, `git diff d0587cc..HEAD --stat`, and a bare `git rev-parse HEAD`). Without gh/git, the PR diff, file list, intent, and head SHA were unreadable, and the second freshness check couldn't run.

No reviewers were spawned: subagents share the same Bash sandbox and could not fetch the change, so any review would have been speculative. PR #224 was NOT reviewed. Treat this round as incomplete and re-run once the runner's sandbox can create a user namespace (CAP_SYS_ADMIN / unprivileged userns), even though spawned == returned (both empty).
